principle: Leon composes interfaces from reviewed components. It does not invent new UI patterns for high-risk flows.

product_shell.name: Leon
product_shell.experience: A calm personal AI environment that opens directly into status, memory, work and intent surfaces.

use: modular canvas with one to three priority surfaces
floating bottom dock for connected spaces
assistant presence tied to current status
adaptive transparency for details, logs, sources and policy
control-plane panels only as supporting inspection surfaces
avoid: standard chatbot layout as the default product shell
dense SaaS dashboard grids as the first impression
marketing landing pages before the working environment
decorative motion that does not communicate state

visual_design_rules.dark_soft_backgrounds: Use layered near-black and blue-black fields instead of flat black.
visual_design_rules.subtle_gradients_or_noise: Use low-contrast radial gradients plus fine noise to create depth without visual clutter.
visual_design_rules.glass_panels: Panels use translucent fills, backdrop blur and inner highlights.
visual_design_rules.rounded_corners: Use generous rounded corners on shell panels and smaller radii on operational cards.
visual_design_rules.blur: Use blur for depth and transparency, never to hide critical safety text.
visual_design_rules.glow: Glow is soft and status-aware around Leon presence, focus rings and active surfaces.
visual_design_rules.shadow: Shadows are diffuse and layered, supporting depth without heavy borders.
visual_design_rules.whitespace: Prefer spacious grouping and one to three primary surfaces over dense dashboard packing.
visual_design_rules.minimal_borders: Borders are subtle hairlines used only for structure, affordance or safety separation.
visual_design_rules.dynamic_accent_color: Exactly one dynamic accent drives active glow, progress and selected dock state.

idle.label: idle/rest
idle.usage: calm availability and resting Leon presence

acting.label: acting/executing
acting.usage: approved execution or active local work

attention.label: attention/review
attention.usage: approval, missing input, risk review or blocker

error.label: error/danger
error.usage: real failure, danger or policy violation only

home.purpose: Daily command center and project overview.

chat.purpose: Fast direct interaction for compact answers and light context.

workflows.purpose: Reviewable multi-step work, orchestration proposals and agent assignments.

memory.purpose: Inspectable and correctable memory and graph relationships.

skills.purpose: Approved skills, tool candidates, MCP reviews, permission checks and gated approvals.

projects.purpose: Project context, research boards, source stacks and active work surfaces.

settings.purpose: Secrets, safety boundaries, model routes and local runtime policy.

canvas_shell.continuity: Spaces are areas of one environment. Dock changes move focus across the same canvas instead of loading unrelated pages.

core_actions.label: Brief
core_actions.aria_label: Generate or inspect the morning brief

animation_system.principle: Motion communicates spatial continuity, state change and focus only. It must stay restrained and all information must remain readable without motion.

magnetic_move.purpose: Pull active elements subtly toward the logical focus point.

character_renderer.principle: Leon character motion is functional status communication, not decoration. It is derived from runtime state and never implies execution when the system is only previewing.
character_renderer.red_usage: Red is reserved for real error, danger, failed run, failed task, or policy violation states only.

target_behavior.acting: Point toward the active execution/work component.
target_behavior.interacting: Point toward the reviewable or user-manipulated component.

ProjectStatusCard.purpose: Show current phase, progress and next recommended task.

NeedInputQueue.purpose: Surface pending approvals, missing secrets and blocked tasks.

ActiveTaskList.purpose: Show open tasks without hiding status/risk/owner.

MorningBriefCard.purpose: Placeholder for future morning report; no autonomous execution.

CommandBar.purpose: Start a request or route preview without claiming execution.

AssistantStatusPill.purpose: Show assistant state such as idle, thinking, waiting, blocked, reviewing or done.

ContextCard.purpose: Show compact relevant context and why it is relevant.

SafeResponseCard.purpose: Show direct answer, refusal or safe redirect without hidden tool execution.

ResearchBoard.purpose: Show plan, method, subtasks and uncertainty for research work.

TaskTimeline.purpose: Show event sequence for tasks, previews, runs and audits.

UncertaintyCard.purpose: Show missing inputs, assumptions and unresolved decisions.

TaskQueue.purpose: Show queued and active work with state transitions.

OrchestrationProposalCard.purpose: Show prepared proposals before applying local task/approval changes.

AgentRunCard.purpose: Show agent assignments and runs with allowed/forbidden actions.

MemoryCard.purpose: Show memory content, confidence, source, expiry and edit/delete controls.

MemoryGraphEdgeList.purpose: Show simple graph relationships with source memory and confidence.

MemoryReviewQueue.purpose: Show candidate, sensitive or long-term memory requiring review.

ToolManifestCard.purpose: Show tool/MCP candidates, scope, cost/resource profile and status.

PermissionCheckCard.purpose: Show local preflight decision before any tool action.

ApprovalSheet.purpose: Show high-impact action preview, risk, cost, rollback and explicit decision controls.

McpIntakeCard.purpose: Show MCP candidate review checklist without install/connect/write.

SecretIntakeCard.purpose: Write-only local env key intake; never show secret values.

ModelRouteCard.purpose: Show dynamic model routing and local GPU readiness without changing runtime.

TaskCard.purpose: Show a single blocked or reviewable task with status, risk and next action.

safety_invariants: approval actions must be explicit and accessible
high-risk flows must include an approval or policy component
memory must remain inspectable and editable
tool execution state must never be implied when execution_allowed=false
motion must be subtle or disabled and never carry essential information
